title: Background Tasks
description: Slow commands go through unified_exec: wait a yield window, return a session_id if still running, harvest later with write_stdin.

steps.content: Run a long repository scan and tell me when it finishes.
steps.annotation: The user asks for work that will outlive a single yield window.

steps.content: I'll start the scan with exec_command. If it is still running after the yield window, I'll keep working and harvest with write_stdin.
steps.annotation: The model chooses unified_exec instead of blocking on a synchronous shell.
exec_command spawns the child and waits up to yield_time_ms.
The client event stream (TUI) sees Begin. This is not model input.

steps.content:
session_id: 1
status: still running
poll with write_stdin({ session_id: 1, chars: "" })
steps.annotation: The yield window ended. The model gets a handle, not the final output.
Empty chars is a poll: wait another yield window and harvest.
Exit is emitted to the client stream. The idle session does not auto-wake the model.
The model sees the result only because it polled write_stdin.

steps.content: The scan finished with 12 matches. I'll summarize the most important ones now.
steps.annotation: The agent consumes the harvested tool result, not a pushed notification.
